R1: Walk me through how you would improve the checkout conversion rate on our e-commerce platform. Currently, we have a 65% cart abandonment rate. What data would you analyze, what hypotheses would you form, and what product changes would you prioritize?

A significant number of users are adding products to their cart but not completing the purchase within 24 hours. Design a feature to recover these abandoned carts. What channels would you use (email, push notifications, SMS), what messaging would you test, and how would you measure success?

Our search functionality is underperforming – only 40% of searches result in a click, and 60% result in no results found. How would you diagnose the problem? What improvements would you make to search relevance, filters, and the overall search experience?

Design a product recommendation system for an e-commerce homepage. How would you decide what to recommend (trending products, personalized suggestions, editorial picks)? What signals would you use for personalization, and how would you A/B test different recommendation algorithms?

We're seeing that customers who use our mobile app have 3x higher lifetime value compared to mobile web users. How would you drive more users to download and actively use the app? What features would be app-exclusive, and what incentives would you offer?

Our average order value (AOV) is ₹800, but we want to increase it to ₹1,200. What product features or strategies would you implement? Consider cross-selling, upselling, bundling, minimum order requirements, and free shipping thresholds.

Design a ratings and reviews system for products. How would you encourage more users to leave reviews? How would you handle fake reviews or review manipulation? What weightage would you give to verified purchases versus unverified reviews?

We want to launch a subscription service (similar to Amazon Prime) that offers free shipping, early access to sales, and exclusive deals. Walk me through how you would design this product, price it, and measure whether it's successful.

Our return rate is 25% for fashion and apparel, which is hurting profitability. How would you reduce returns without hurting customer satisfaction? Consider better product information, size guides, AR try-on, or stricter return policies.

Design a flash sale feature for our platform. How would you handle the technical challenges of high traffic spikes? How would you create urgency without frustrating users who miss out? What anti-abuse measures would you implement to prevent bots?

We're planning to add a social commerce feature where users can share products, create wishlists, and get recommendations from friends. How would you design this feature? What privacy concerns would you address, and how would you measure engagement?
Our platform has 10,000 sellers, but only 500 contribute to 80% of GMV. How would you design seller tools and incentives to activate the long-tail of sellers and improve catalog quality?

Walk me through how you would design a seamless guest checkout experience versus encouraging users to create an account. What is the trade-off between conversion rate and creating registered users for future marketing?

We want to expand into grocery delivery with 10-minute delivery promise. What are the key product considerations? How would you design the inventory management, dark store selection, and delivery assignment system?

Design a loyalty program for our e-commerce platform. How would customers earn points? What rewards would you offer? How would you ensure the program is profitable and doesn't just subsidize existing customers who would have purchased anyway?

Our customer support is overwhelmed with queries about 'Where is my order?' How would you design a self-service order tracking experience that reduces support tickets? What proactive notifications would you send at each stage of fulfillment?

We're seeing high drop-off at the payment stage (30% of users abandon after entering shipping details). How would you diagnose the problem? What payment methods would you add, and how would you optimize the payment page design?

Design a feature that allows customers to schedule deliveries for a specific date and time slot. What are the operational complexities? How would you price this feature, and what restrictions would you put in place?

Our competitors are offering same-day delivery, but we currently offer 2-3 day delivery. How would you evaluate whether to invest in same-day delivery? What cities would you launch in first, and how would you measure ROI?

Walk me through how you would prioritize features on your product roadmap. If you have 10 feature requests (from customers, sellers, executives, and your own team), how would you decide which to build first? What framework would you use?
R2: Case: Cart Abandonment Recovery - Our data shows that 70% of users who abandon their carts have items worth more than ₹2,000. Design the complete solution including triggers, communication channels, messaging strategy, discount mechanics, and success metrics. How would you prevent abuse of the system?

Case: Search Quality Improvement - Users are complaining that search results are not relevant. When someone searches for 'running shoes for women,' they're seeing men's shoes, cricket shoes, and unrelated products. You have 3 months to fix search. What would be your approach?

Case: New Category Launch - Your company wants to launch a new category: Electronics (currently you only do fashion). What product requirements would be different for electronics? How would you design the catalog structure, product detail pages, warranty information, installation services, and return policies?

Case: International Expansion - Your e-commerce platform is successful in India and wants to expand to Southeast Asia. What product changes would be needed? Consider payment methods, language localization, logistics partners, seller onboarding, and regulatory compliance.
Case: Conversion Rate Optimization - The product detail page conversion rate is 8%, but you believe it should be 12%. You have 6 weeks to improve it. Walk me through your experimentation plan.

Case: Personalization Engine - Build a personalization engine that shows different homepage content to different users. What user signals would you collect? How would you segment users? What content would you personalize?

Case: Fraud Prevention - You're seeing an increase in fraudulent orders. Design a fraud detection and prevention system. What signals would you monitor? At what point in the user journey would you intervene?
Case: Marketplace Quality - Your marketplace has quality issues – some sellers sell counterfeit products, some have poor packaging, some ship very late. Design a seller quality score system.

Case: Mobile App vs Mobile Web - Currently, 60% of your traffic is mobile web and 40% is mobile app. App users have 2x higher conversion and 3x better retention. Should you invest heavily in app growth or improve mobile web?

Case: Pricing Strategy for Premium Membership - You want to launch a premium membership similar to Amazon Prime. How would you price it? What analysis would you do to determine the optimal price point?

Case: Dark Patterns Audit - A regulator has raised concerns that your platform uses dark patterns. Audit your product and identify potential dark patterns. How would you redesign these features to be ethical while still achieving business goals?

Case: Returns Management - Returns are costing 5% of revenue. Design a product solution to reduce returns. Consider virtual try-on, better size recommendations, stricter return windows, or partial refunds.
Case: Voice Commerce - Your CEO wants to explore voice commerce (Alexa, Google Assistant integration). How would you design the voice shopping experience?

Case: Social Commerce Integration - Integrate Instagram/WhatsApp shopping into your platform. Users should be able to discover products on social media and complete purchases seamlessly. Design the integration.

Case: Sustainability Initiatives - Customers are increasingly conscious about sustainability. Design features to highlight eco-friendly products, carbon-neutral shipping options, and packaging choices.
R3: Tell me about the most impactful product you built in your previous role. What was the problem you were solving, what was your approach, and what were the measurable results?
Describe a situation where you had to make a difficult product trade-off between user experience and business metrics. How did you make the decision, and what was the outcome?
Give me an example of when you launched a feature that failed or didn't meet expectations. What went wrong, how did you identify the failure, and what did you do to course-correct?
Tell me about a time when you had to say 'no' to a feature request from executives, sales, or an important customer. How did you communicate your decision?
Describe a situation where you had to prioritize your roadmap under significant constraints. How did you decide what to cut and what to keep?
Give me an example of when you used data to challenge conventional wisdom or gut feeling. What was the assumption, what did the data show?
Tell me about a time when you had to work with a difficult or underperforming engineering team. How did you build trust and ensure quality delivery?
Describe a situation where you identified a major user pain point that no one else had noticed. How did you discover it and what solution did you build?
Give me an example of when you had to make a product decision with incomplete data or high uncertainty. What was your framework?
Tell me about a time when you had to collaborate with cross-functional teams to launch a complex initiative. How did you align everyone?
Describe your experience running A/B tests. Have you ever had a test result that surprised you?
Give me an example of when you had to manage scope creep or feature bloat. How did you keep the team focused?
Tell me about a time when you had to advocate for technical debt reduction. How did you build the business case?
Describe a situation where customer feedback fundamentally changed your product direction.
Give me an example of how you stay updated with industry trends, competitor products, and emerging technologies in e-commerce.
R4: If I give you access to our database, what are the first 10 metrics you would look at to understand the health of our e-commerce business?
Our month-over-month GMV growth has slowed from 15% to 8%. Walk me through how you would diagnose the problem.
We ran an A/B test where the treatment group saw a new checkout flow. Treatment had 12% conversion vs. 10% control, but average order value dropped from ₹1,000 to ₹900. Should we ship this change?
Define and explain these e-commerce metrics: GMV, Take Rate, Contribution Margin, CAC, LTV, Repeat Purchase Rate, and NPS. How would you improve each?
Our CAC has increased from ₹300 to ₹500 over the past 6 months, while LTV has remained flat at ₹2,000. What could be causing CAC to increase?
How would you measure the success of a new feature like product recommendations on homepage? What are your North Star metric, supporting metrics, and guardrail metrics?
We're seeing that 30% of orders are prepaid and 70% are COD. COD orders have 20% RTO rate vs. 5% for prepaid. How would you shift the mix toward prepaid?
Build a framework to evaluate whether to enter a new city. What metrics would you consider?
Our app has 5 million MAU, but only 2 million transacting users. How would you measure and improve activation?
We're launching a new payment method (buy now, pay later). How would you set success metrics?
Our repeat purchase rate is 40% in the first 3 months but drops to 20% after 6 months. What could be causing this drop-off?
If you had to choose only 3 metrics to run this e-commerce business, what would they be and why?
We're considering offering free shipping on all orders vs. free shipping above ₹500. Build a financial model to evaluate this decision.
Our platform shows 100,000 products, but 80% of GMV comes from just 5,000 products. How would you analyze this long tail?
Walk me through how you would measure and attribute marketing channel effectiveness with multi-touch attribution.
R5: Tell me about yourself and your journey into product management. What attracted you to e-commerce specifically?
What do you know about our company, our products, our competitive position, and our recent initiatives?
What are your salary expectations? What is your current CTC, and what is your notice period?
Where do you see yourself in 3-5 years?
Product management requires working with ambiguity and changing priorities. How do you handle situations where requirements are unclear?
This role requires collaboration with multiple stakeholders who often have conflicting priorities. How would you describe your stakeholder management style?
E-commerce moves very fast with aggressive timelines. Are you comfortable working in a high-pressure environment?
What is your approach to work-life balance?
Tell me about a product or feature (not necessarily one you built) that you admire. What makes it great from a product perspective?
What frameworks or methodologies do you use in product management (RICE, KANO, Jobs-to-be-Done, OKRs)?
How do you stay customer-obsessed? What methods do you use to understand user needs?
Are you willing to relocate or travel frequently if needed?
What professional development or learning are you pursuing?
Describe your ideal product team structure.
Do you have any questions for us about our product roadmap, team culture, growth plans, or what success looks like in this role?
